nodes.text: Every band answers to a *reaver*, the one who keeps the shares. Break the biggest camp standing and take his mark. Then carry it past me, to *Ansel* at the Waykeepers' Hall. The registry outlives my temper. Will you do it?
By the coat, and by everyone else standing behind him. Find the camp with a name in it. Mind the archers.
Then it keeps. Reavers always do.
